verdict.rationale: Alloy documents stable identifiers for reconciliation: External Entity IDs, including retroactive assignment, multiple IDs per entity and entity merging. It also returns decision data programmatically through Evaluation and Events API responses and sends webhooks on manual-review events. However, nothing documents an actual export of customer, alert, case and decision data. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or reporting export capability, coverage of alert and case data, explicit identifiers on alerts/cases/decisions for reconciliation, and independent corroboration.
